name: SAT Prep Digital: Satwick
subtitle: SAT Math, Reading & Writing
shortDescription: Adaptive digital SAT practice: mock tests, a daily plan, graphing calculator and full worked solutions. No account.
longDescription:
Prepare for the digital SAT with adaptive mock tests, math, reading and writing practice. Satwick builds a short daily plan from the topics you most need, brings questions back right before you would forget them, and keeps every miss in a mistake notebook with the full solution.

### Practice That Adapts
Original SAT-style math, reading and writing questions, each with a worked solution, a reason for every answer choice and a similar question to try. Timed section and full mock tests follow the digital two-module format.

### Built-in Tools
A graphing calculator and a basic calculator open from every math question, plus interactive labs for lines, parabolas, circles, the unit circle, systems, probability, transitions and more.

### Personal and Private
A topic mastery map, a rough practice estimate (never a predicted score), a streak that never nags, and export of your progress to a file. No account, works offline, and your progress stays on your device.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
